newsitem.title: CHINA: EASTERN COMMUNICATIONS INTERIM NET UP.
newsitem.headline: EASTERN COMMUNICATIONS INTERIM NET UP.

text.p: Half year ended June 31, 1997 (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1996 figures)
Company name: Eastern Communications Co Ltd
The company, China's largest mobile phone maker, listed its B shares in August 1996.
Note: The results were contained in a company statement released by the Shanghai Stock Exchange on Tuesday.
The figures are unaudited, as Chinese securities rules do not require listed firms to have their interim results audited.
The company has proposed a five-to-10 bonus share issue, pending approval of shareholders.
Trading in the company's A and B shares would be suspended on Wednesday morning and would resume in the afternoon.
